ironlash.shortDesc: Whiplash; tail hits raise Sp. Def once per turn.

ironmountain.name: Iron Mountain
ironmountain.desc: This Pokemon has Filter, Stamina, and Heavy Metal's effects. Super-effective attacks deal 0.75x damage to it. Once per turn when hit by an opposing damaging move, its Defense rises by 1 stage and it restores 1/16 max HP. Its weight is doubled.

ironvise.name: Iron Vise
ironvise.desc: Tough Claws + Battle Armor + Light Metal + Intimidate. Strengthens contact moves, reduces incoming damage and prevents critical hits, lowers weight, and lowers foes' Attack on entry.
ironvise.shortDesc: Tough Claws + Battle Armor + Light Metal + Intimidate.

ironwill.name: Iron Will
ironwill.desc: Prism Armor + Second Wind + Self Sufficient + Whiplash. Raises Accuracy by one stage on entry and strengthens tail moves by 50%.
ironwill.shortDesc: Prism Armor + Second Wind + Self Sufficient + Whiplash.

islandcurrent.name: Island Current
islandcurrent.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim and Wind Rider's effects.

joyride.name: Joyride
joyride.desc: Aerilate + Violent Rush + Vital Spirit. On its first active turn, Speed rises 50% and Attack 20%; eligible Normal moves become Flying.

keeneye.name: Keen Eye
keeneye.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage. On activation, reveals all opposing active Illusions, including itemless foes; this is not a continuous effect.
keeneye.shortDesc: Reveals opposing Illusions on activation; This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.

keenhunt.name: Keen Hunt
keenhunt.desc: Opponents cannot lower its Speed. Rock moves cannot miss and gain +1 critical-hit stage against targets at half HP or less.
keenhunt.shortDesc: Speed cannot be lowered by foes; Rock moves gain accuracy and crits vs. low-HP foes.

kickfiend.name: Kick Fiend
kickfiend.desc: This Pokemon has Striker, Violent Rush, and Limber's effects.

kindledfury.name: Kindled Fury
kindledfury.desc: Fluffy + Guts + Flash Fire. Fire attacks are absorbed, status strengthens physical attacks, and contact damage is reduced. Does not include Brute Force.

knightsguard.name: Knight's Guard
knightsguard.desc: Once per switch-in in doubles, redirects the first single-target damaging attack aimed at an adjacent ally to this Pokemon. It takes 25% less damage from that attack and, if it survives a hit, gains one Attack stage. Spread moves and status moves are not redirected.
knightsguard.shortDesc: Once per switch-in, intercepts an ally-targeted attack; takes 25% less and gains +1 Atk if hit.

knuckletide.name: Knuckle Tide
knuckletide.desc: Has Iron Fist's full effect: punching moves have 1.4x power. After a punch damages a foe, the next physical or special Water-type attack to damage a foe ignores positive Defense or Sp. Def stat stages, respectively. A miss or Water-type status move does not spend the charge.
knuckletide.shortDesc: Iron Fist; a landed punch primes the next landed Water attack to ignore positive defensive boosts.

lanceguard.name: Lanceguard
lanceguard.desc: Shell Armor, including this server's damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Blocking a contact move with Protect lowers the attacker's Defense by 1 stage.
lanceguard.shortDesc: Shell Armor; blocking contact with Protect lowers the attacker's Defense.

lancepoint.name: Lance Point
lancepoint.desc: Has Keen Eye's full effect: opponents cannot lower its accuracy and its moves ignore the target's evasion boosts. On Mirror Arena, gains one accuracy stage and Laser Focus on entry. Drill moves gain one critical-hit stage and do not make contact. Critical-hit prevention still applies. Does not include Sniper.
lancepoint.shortDesc: Keen Eye; drill moves gain +1 critical-hit stage and do not make contact.

lastbrood.name: Last Brood
lastbrood.desc: Swarm. Once per battle, surviving an opposing hit that crosses from above half HP to half or less creates a Substitute with 1/8 maximum HP, at no HP cost. Cannot replace an existing Substitute.
lastbrood.shortDesc: Swarm; once per battle, crossing half HP creates a 1/8-HP Substitute.

lastlaugh.name: Last Laugh
lastlaugh.desc: If no other active Pokemon has a move left to use this turn, this Pokemon's damaging attack bypasses Substitute. Damaging a foe with that attack restores 1/8 maximum HP, once per turn.
lastlaugh.shortDesc: When no other Pokemon will move this turn, its hit bypasses Substitute and heals 1/8.

layeredcoat.name: Layered Coat
layeredcoat.desc: This Pokemon has Fur Coat and Overcoat's effects.

layeredshell.name: Layered Shell
layeredshell.desc: Shell Armor. Once per switch-in, its first opposing special hit deals a further 25% less damage. Includes this server's Shell Armor critical-hit immunity, 20% damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects.
layeredshell.shortDesc: Shell Armor; the first special hit each entry deals 25% less damage.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.
levitate.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

lifeguard.name: Life Guard
lifeguard.desc: Friend Guard + Sworn Duty + full Propeller Tail. In Free-for-All only, successfully blocking an opposing damaging move with a protection move earns a guard that reduces the next opposing damaging hit by 25%, through the end of the following turn. It does not stack or refresh while active, is consumed by only one hit, and clears on switching. Merely using protection, blocking status moves or residual damage does not earn or consume it.
lifeguard.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Sworn Duty + Propeller Tail; FFA successful protection earns one 25% guard.

lightningrod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningrod.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. It redirects single-target Electric moves within range to itself. On Electric Terrain, both stats rise by 1 stage on entry.
lightningrod.shortDesc: Draws Electric moves to raise Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.

limber.name: Limber
limber.desc: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed, cures paralysis if it gains this Ability, and cannot have its Speed lowered by another Pokemon or field effects, including field Speed multipliers. Self-inflicted Speed costs and held-item slowdowns still apply. This does not change Trick Room ordering or prevent losing positive Speed boosts or Tailwind.
limber.shortDesc: Cannot be paralyzed or have Speed reduced by other Pokemon or field effects.

livenet.name: Live Net
livenet.desc: Unnerve. While active, Sticky Web placed by this Pokemon also deals 1/16 maximum HP of Electric damage to grounded entrants. Heavy-Duty Boots, hazard immunity and Electric immunity prevent the added damage.
livenet.shortDesc: Unnerve; its Sticky Web also chips grounded entrants with Electric damage.

livewire.name: Livewire
livewire.desc: Transistor + Volt Absorb + Quick Feet + Iron Barbs. Electric attacks heal this Pokemon instead of damaging it. Its Electric attacks are boosted, its Speed rises while statused or on Electric Terrain, and contact attackers lose HP.
livewire.shortDesc: Transistor + Volt Absorb + Quick Feet + Iron Barbs.

livinglegend.name: Living Legend
livinglegend.desc: This Pokemon has Flash Fire, Download, and Sheer Force. Hidden effect: Extreme Speed has 1.5x power.
livinglegend.shortDesc: Flash Fire + Download + Sheer Force; Extreme Speed 1.5x.

livingtangle.name: Living Tangle
livingtangle.desc: Tangling Hair + Stamina. Contact attackers lose 1 Speed stage. Opposing hits raise Defense once per turn and restore 1/16 maximum HP per hit, as this server's Stamina does.
livingtangle.shortDesc: Tangling Hair + Stamina; contact slows foes while opposing hits raise Defense and heal.

lockjaw.name: Lockjaw
lockjaw.desc: Strong Jaw. Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.
lockjaw.shortDesc: Strong Jaw. Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.

longreach.name: Long Reach
longreach.desc: Removes contact and raises critical-hit rate by one stage. Also raises Accuracy on entry and retains field bonuses. No triple critical-hit damage. Full local Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus; shared accuracy entry rewards apply once.
longreach.shortDesc: Super Luck + Keen Eye; Removes contact and raises critical-hit rate by one stage.

loyalguard.name: Loyal Guard
loyalguard.desc: This Pokemon has Friend Guard, Guard Dog, and Intimidate's effects.

lunardread.name: Lunar Dread
lunardread.desc: Dishearten + Insomnia + Pressure. On entry, lowers adjacent foes Sp. Atk by 1 stage, blocked by Substitute and normal stat-drop protection. Prevents sleep and Yawn; Dark and Ghost attacks have 1.3x power. Retains local Pressure: lowers foes Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage on entry (2 on Cold Eclipse), costs foes 1 extra PP (2 on Midnight Zone), and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. No mark, damage-reduction or Ground critical-hit effects.
lunardread.shortDesc: Dishearten + Insomnia + Pressure; retains their local field effects.

lunaridol.name: Lunar Idol
lunaridol.desc: This Pokemon has Levitate's Ground immunity and is immune to hail damage. Its Ice-type moves have 1.5x power, and its Special Attack is 1.5x during hail or snow.
lunaridol.shortDesc: Levitate; immune to hail; Ice power 1.5x; Sp. Atk 1.5x in hail/snow.

lunarorbit.name: Lunar Orbit
lunarorbit.desc: This Pokemon has Magic Bounce, Serene Grace, Triage, and Magic Guard. On switch-in or Mega Evolution, it sets Gravity for 5 turns and sinks Water Surface to Underwater, Underwater to Midnight Zone, or Corrosive Mist to Corrosive. These field changes do not occur on New World.
lunarorbit.shortDesc: Magic Bounce + Serene Grace + Triage + Magic Guard; sets Gravity and sinks fields.

lunarspirit.name: Lunar Spirit
lunarspirit.desc: This Pokemon has STAB on Psychic- and Normal-type moves.
lunarspirit.shortDesc: Psychic- and Normal-type moves get STAB.

malicewell.name: Malice Well
malicewell.desc: Full Flame Body: contact attackers have a 30% burn chance (60% on Volcanic Field); Cold Eclipse instead grants +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry and disables contact burns. Once per actual entry, the first opposing damaging move that executes against this Pokemon grants +1 Sp. Atk after the entire move finishes if it remains active and survives, including Protect, misses and immunity. All hits and spread targets share one activation. Ally moves, self damage, residual damage and moves that never execute do not qualify. Ability changes or suppression do not reset usage. The activation is consumed even at +6; switching resets usage and normal stat stages, and Haze removes the boost without refreshing usage.
malicewell.shortDesc: Flame Body; first hostile damaging move per entry: +1 SpA after survival, even through Protect.

marshconduit.name: Marsh Conduit
marshconduit.desc: Has Water Absorb's full effect, including healing from Water moves and qualifying water fields. The first Water move it absorbs each switch-in also lowers each active foe's Speed by one stage.
marshconduit.shortDesc: Water Absorb; first absorbed Water move each switch-in lowers foes' Speed by 1.

masonsfist.name: Mason's Fist
masonsfist.desc: Has Iron Fist's full effect. When a punching move damages a foe, it removes Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Arenite Wall, and Atlantis Wall from that foe's side.
masonsfist.shortDesc: Iron Fist; punches that damage a foe break that side's screens.

mastercourse.name: Master Course
mastercourse.desc: Contrary. Once per turn, damaging a foe with a Water or Dragon attack gives an adjacent ally +1 critical-hit stage for its next damaging move. The charge does not stack and ends on switching out.
mastercourse.shortDesc: Contrary; Water or Dragon hits grant an adjacent ally +1 critical-hit stage.

masterkey.name: Master Key
masterkey.desc: Single-target status moves bypass Substitute and ignore opposing abilities under normal Mold Breaker rules. No priority boost. Accuracy, Protect, type/status immunities, Safeguard, terrain and Taunt still apply.
masterkey.shortDesc: Single-target status moves bypass Substitute and ignore opposing abilities.

memoryleak.name: Memory Leak
memoryleak.desc: Positive stat boosts this Pokemon would receive are passed to an adjacent ally instead.
memoryleak.shortDesc: Passes positive stat boosts to an adjacent ally.

meridianseal.name: Meridian Seal
meridianseal.desc: Its first Fighting hit against a surviving foe each entry attempts to suppress that foe's Ability for 2 turns, including the current turn. Protect, Substitute, Ability Shield and unsuppressible Abilities prevent suppression. Switching clears the seal.
meridianseal.shortDesc: First Fighting hit each entry suppresses the foe's Ability for 2 turns.

mightyjaw.name: Mighty Jaw
mightyjaw.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw and Intimidate's effects. On its first action after switching in, its biting moves have 2 higher priority.
mightyjaw.shortDesc: Proficient; Strong Jaw + Intimidate; biting moves gain +2 priority on first action.

mimecraft.name: Mimecraft
mimecraft.desc: Reflect and Light Screen gain +1 priority. Once per switch-in, the first one this Pokemon successfully sets heals its lowest-HP active ally by 1/8 of that ally's maximum HP.
mimecraft.shortDesc: +1 priority for Reflect and Light Screen; first successful screen heals an ally by 1/8.

mindfreeze.name: Mind Freeze
mindfreeze.desc: This Pokemon cannot have this Ability suppressed. It is immune to Ice-type attacks and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP when hit by one. It has Ice Body's healing and hail immunity. Its damaging Psychic-type moves have a 40% chance to cause frostbite, and Freezing Glare's frostbite chance is doubled. Its Physical Ice-type moves become Special.
mindfreeze.shortDesc: Cannot be suppressed; Ice immunity heals 1/4; Ice Body; Psychic may frostbite.

mirechorus.name: Mire Chorus
mirechorus.desc: Has Liquid Voice and Poison Touch's effects. Each foe damaged by a noncontact sound move also has an independent 20% chance to be poisoned. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this added poison chance.
mirechorus.shortDesc: Liquid Voice + Poison Touch; noncontact sound hits have a 20% poison chance.

mirrorgreed.name: Mirror Greed
mirrorgreed.desc: This Pokemon has Magic Bounce, Analytic, and Filter's effects.

moonlightvigil.name: Moonlight Vigil
moonlightvigil.desc: Inner Focus + Pressure + Illuminate. Prevents flinching, drains extra PP, and ignores opposing evasion.

moonlitwings.name: Moonlit Wings
moonlitwings.desc: This Pokemon has Serene Grace and gains STAB on Fairy-type moves.

moonveil.name: Moon Veil
moonveil.desc: Pastel Veil + Misty Surge. On entry, sets Misty Terrain, or Misty Aura over a compatible existing field. This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned and are cured of poison when this Ability becomes active. Opposing Poison-type moves lower their user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. Retains Pastel Veil's field effects.

mossarmor.name: Moss Armor
mossarmor.desc: Levitate + Stamina + full Natural Cure. In addition, switching out heals 1/8 maximum HP only after a Grass attack dealt opposing HP damage on the current or immediately preceding turn, with no intervening action. Natural Cure still cures status and heals 1/3 maximum HP when it does so. No Regenerator.
mossarmor.shortDesc: Levitate + Stamina + Natural Cure; conditional 1/8 Grass-attack switch healing.

motordrive.name: Motor Drive
motordrive.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
motordrive.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.

mountainbreaker.name: Mountainbreaker
mountainbreaker.desc: Damaging Rock moves remain Rock-type with normal Rock STAB, but use the better overall Rock or Ground type-chart effectiveness against each target. Ground-immune typings do not replace the Rock matchup. No extra power multiplier.
mountainbreaker.shortDesc: Rock moves use the better Rock/Ground matchup without changing type.

mountainhunger.name: Mountain Hunger
mountainhunger.desc: Sap Sipper + Thick Fat + Early Bird. Absorbs Grass moves, takes less damage from Fire and Ice moves, and wakes from sleep faster.
mountainhunger.shortDesc: Sap Sipper + Thick Fat + Early Bird.

mountainrift.name: Mountain Rift
mountainrift.desc: Combines Shell Armor and Self Sufficient. It cannot be critically hit, takes 0.8x damage, gains 2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats, heals 1/16 maximum HP each turn, and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. On entry, it creates Mountain Field for 5 turns. Once at half HP or less, it starts Gravity and resets Mountain Field to 5 turns. Its four moves are always Earthquake, Sand Tomb, Mountain Gale, and Stone Edge. The first time it would faint, it instead revives at full HP as Torterra-Rift-Shatter, clearing its status, boosts, and volatile conditions.
mountainrift.shortDesc: Shell Armor + Self Sufficient; 5-turn Mountain; half HP: Gravity + Mountain reset; first faint: full reset into Shatter.

mourningcoat.name: Mourning Coat
mourningcoat.desc: Fluffy. After a teammate has fainted, Fluffy's extra Fire weakness is removed for the rest of battle; contact damage reduction remains.
mourningcoat.shortDesc: Fluffy; its extra Fire weakness ends after a teammate faints.

mourningsnow.name: Mourning Snow
mourningsnow.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Hail for 8 turns, and Aurora Veil used by this Pokemon lasts 8 turns. During Hail or Snow, it heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Its damaging moves of any type gain an additional 30% chance to inflict frostbite, preserving their existing effects; this does not require weather. It is immune to Hail damage. When another Pokemon faints, it restores 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 if the faint was caused by an Ice move, Hail, Snow, or Curse. When it faints, all opposing Pokemon become cursed. Damaging hits disable the attacker's move when possible.
mourningsnow.shortDesc: Snow Warning + Ice Body; 8-turn Hail/Veil; damaging moves add 30% frostbite; faint healing/curse; hit Disable.

mourningvessel.name: Mourning Vessel
mourningvessel.desc: This Pokemon has Prankster's and Magic Guard's effects. Its damaging moves deal 20% more damage for each fainted ally, up to 2x damage. At the end of each turn, it restores 5% of its max HP for each fainted opposing Pokemon, counting every opposing side in Free-For-All battles.
mourningvessel.shortDesc: Prankster + Magic Guard; fallen allies boost damage; foes fainted heal 5% each turn.

mudmeditation.name: Mud Meditation
mudmeditation.desc: While waiting to perform a selected status move, takes 25% less damage from special attacks. The protection ends when its action resolves or is cancelled.
mudmeditation.shortDesc: Takes 25% less special damage while waiting to use a status move.

mudtemper.name: Mud Temper
mudtemper.desc: Battle Armor, including this server's critical-hit immunity, 20% damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Surviving an opposing Fire or Water hit raises Sp. Def by 1 stage once per turn.
mudtemper.shortDesc: Battle Armor; surviving a Fire or Water hit raises Sp. Def once per turn.

mythicscale.name: Mythic Scale
mythicscale.desc: Marvel Scale + Levitate + Compound Eyes + Shield Dust, including their field effects. Once per switch-in, directly using a powder move to successfully inflict a non-volatile status on an opponent raises Defense by 1. Called or reflected moves and G-Max Befuddle do not trigger this bonus.
mythicscale.shortDesc: Marvel Scale + Levitate + Compound Eyes + Shield Dust; first direct powder status gives +1 Def.

naturalrecovery.name: Natural Recovery
naturalrecovery.desc: This Pokemon has Natural Cure and Regenerator's effects.

neurotoxin.name: Neurotoxin
neurotoxin.desc: Hydra Bond + Shed Skin + Regenerator. Biting moves do not gain Strong Jaw power.

neutralization.name: Neutralization
neutralization.desc: Once per target per move, when this Pokemon directly hits an opposing Pokemon, the target's higher attacking stat is lowered by 1 stage. Spread hits do not trigger this effect. This does not affect other Neutralization users or Pokemon immune to stat drops. While active, base field changes are neutralized, but Auras can still be created and remain active; Trick Room, Magic Room, and Wonder Room are ended and cannot start; and Rainbow Field ends automatically. It also suppresses Royal Decree's stat reset, screen removal, and ongoing restrictions, including those granted by Empress and Royal Sun. Ice Spinner and Steel Roller still remove terrain normally.
neutralization.shortDesc: Hits lower the foe's higher offensive stat by 1; blocks base field changes, not Auras.

nighthoard.name: Night Hoard
nighthoard.desc: Eating a Berry restores an additional 1/8 maximum HP and primes the next Dark-type biting attack that damages a foe to apply Taunt for 2 turns. Misses and blocked attacks preserve the charge.
nighthoard.shortDesc: Eating a Berry heals 1/8 more and charges the next Dark bite to Taunt.

nighthunt.name: Night Hunt
nighthunt.desc: Strong Jaw + Infiltrator + Intimidate. Biting moves have 1.5x power. Moves bypass substitutes and opposing screens. Lowers adjacent foes' Attack on entry. Full local Frisk reveals opposing Illusions (including itemless foes), reveals held items and independently has a 30% chance to Embargo each opposing item holder for 5 turns. Full local Illuminate prevents opposing accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Mirror Arena lowers opposing accuracy by 1; Starlight Arena raises Special Attack by 2 and places Spotlight on the first adjacent ally in multi-active battles. Shared Illusion reveals occur once.
nighthunt.shortDesc: Strong Jaw + Infiltrator + Intimidate + Frisk + Illuminate.

nightmarepulse.name: Nightmare Pulse
nightmarepulse.desc: Pendulum Swing + Cursed Body + Bad Dreams. On entry, sets Haunted Field for 5 turns if field rules allow. Retains sleep immunity, accurate moves, damage reduction, disabling attackers, and damage to sleeping foes. Does not bypass screens or Substitute. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use.
nightmarepulse.shortDesc: Pendulum Swing + Cursed Body + Bad Dreams; 5-turn Haunted Field on entry.

nightrealm.name: Night Realm
nightrealm.desc: This Pokemon can use Dream Eater and Nightmare on awake targets.
nightrealm.shortDesc: Dream Eater and Nightmare affect awake targets.

noblearmor.name: Noble Armor
noblearmor.desc: This Pokemon has Prism Armor and Ice Body's effects.

nobleconduit.name: Noble Conduit
nobleconduit.desc: This Pokemon has Battery, Solar Power, and Aftermath's effects.

nobledance.name: Noble Dance
nobledance.desc: This Pokemon has Dancer, Hospitality, and Own Tempo's effects.

noblerider.name: Noble Rider
noblerider.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim and Mold Breaker's effects.

noseformation.name: Nose Formation
noseformation.desc: This Pokemon has Filter and Elevate. After it hits, three 20 BP special Mini-Noses each select the strongest of Steel, Electric, or Rock against their current target. They chain to another valid foe after a KO, and their KOs trigger Elevate.
noseformation.shortDesc: Filter; three adaptive 20 BP Mini-Noses chain after KOs and trigger Elevate.

oceanicwings.name: Oceanic Wings
oceanicwings.desc: This Pokemon has Water Absorb, Hydration, and Friend Guard's effects.

omenedge.name: Omen Edge
omenedge.desc: Sharpness + Dual Wield + Pressure; physical Doom Desire on faint. Slicing moves are strengthened. Contact moves no longer gain a separate bonus.
omenedge.shortDesc: Sharpness + Dual Wield + Pressure; physical Doom Desire on faint.

oneiricdust.name: Oneiric Dust
oneiricdust.desc: Psychic Surge. Once per switch-in, its first powder move that successfully hits a foe also lowers that foe's Sp. Def by 1 stage. Misses, immunity and protection do not spend the effect.
oneiricdust.shortDesc: Psychic Surge; the first landed powder move each entry lowers Sp. Def.

openingoverture.name: Opening Overture
openingoverture.desc: Once per switch-in, successfully using a sound move starts Tailwind for 3 turns. An existing longer Tailwind is not shortened.
openingoverture.shortDesc: Once per entry, a successful sound move starts 3-turn Tailwind.

opensky.name: Open Sky
opensky.desc: While itemless, immune to entry-hazard damage, Toxic Spikes poison and Sticky Web Speed drops; Flying moves do not make contact.
opensky.shortDesc: While itemless: immune to entry hazards; Flying moves make no contact.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
opportunist.shortDesc: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

orchardbond.name: Orchard Bond
orchardbond.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond and Harvest's effects.

palmmastery.name: Palm Mastery
palmmastery.desc: Thick Fat. Force Palm always inflicts paralysis when it lands, subject to status immunities. Its paralysis becomes a primary effect rather than a secondary roll.
palmmastery.shortDesc: Thick Fat; Force Palm always paralyzes when it lands.

paradoxengine.name: Paradox Engine
paradoxengine.desc: Speed and Fighting/Electric power rise 30% in their conditions. Speed increases by 30% in sun or Electric Terrain; Fighting- and Electric-type moves gain 30% power.
paradoxengine.shortDesc: Speed and Fighting/Electric power rise 30% in their conditions.

paradoxpower.name: Paradox Power
paradoxpower.desc: This Pokemon has Sheer Force's effect and gains STAB on Electric-type moves.

paradoxpull.name: Paradox Pull
paradoxpull.desc: This Pokemon has Magnet Pull's effect. Its Steel typing only contributes resistances and immunities, not weaknesses.

paradoxwheel.name: Paradox Wheel
paradoxwheel.desc: This Pokemon gains STAB on Steel- and Electric-type moves.

parasitism.name: Parasitism
parasitism.desc: This Pokemon has Dry Skin. While above 50% HP, its weaknesses are neutralized, Magic Guard is active, opposing status moves fail, and opposing attack secondary effects are blocked. The first time Parasect would faint, it fake-faints at 1 HP, then becomes Parasect-Parasite at the end of the turn and revives at full HP. This Ability cannot be suppressed and is immune to Neutralization.
parasitism.shortDesc: Dry Skin; above half: defensive protection; first KO triggers Resuscitation.

patternshift.name: Pattern Shift
patternshift.desc: This Pokemon has Protean, Shed Skin, and Unaware's effects.

pearlcurrent.name: Pearl Current
pearlcurrent.desc: Has Water Absorb's full effect, including its water-field healing. The first Water-type move absorbed each switch-in also heals its lowest-HP active ally by 1/8 of that ally's maximum HP.
pearlcurrent.shortDesc: Water Absorb; first absorbed Water move each switch-in heals an ally by 1/8.

pendulumswing.name: Pendulum Swing
pendulumswing.desc: This Pokemon has Insomnia and Filter's effects. Its moves cannot miss.

peppersting.name: Pepper Sting
peppersting.desc: Insomnia. After using a Fire move, its first Grass attack to damage a foe each switch-in lowers that foe's Speed and Sp. Def by 1 stage. Retains this server's full Insomnia effects.
peppersting.shortDesc: Insomnia; a Fire move primes the next Grass hit to lower Speed and Sp. Def.

perfectego.name: Perfect Ego
perfectego.desc: This Pokemon has Ultra Ego's effects, and its moves cannot miss. Its enhanced-field one-time 1/4 HP pinch recovery is consumed only when it actually restores HP; blocked healing preserves it for a later eligible hit window.

perfectforesight.name: Perfect Foresight
perfectforesight.desc: Includes Insomnia and retains its opposing-ability copying. Automatically applies target-specific Miracle Eye before a direct damaging Psychic move. Direct single-target HP damage stores a 90 BP Psychic special attack; opposing special HP damage stores a 90 BP special attack of the incoming type. Shares one pending attack per opposing trainer (one in singles, up to three in Free-for-All), released one per turn beginning next turn. Snapshots its own level, Special Attack, stages and typing, without copied offensive abilities or items. Queues survive switching/fainting and coexist with ordinary Future Sight; normal live defenses apply. Once per battle when Alakazam Mega Evolves, sets real Reflect and Light Screen for 5 turns without shortening longer screens.
perfectforesight.shortDesc: Trace; Insomnia + ability copy; Miracle Eye; stored attacks; once-per-battle Mega screens.

perfectstriker.name: Perfect Striker
perfectstriker.desc: This Pokemon has Striker, No Guard, and Libero's effects.

perishbody.name: Perish Body
perishbody.desc: If an enemy hits this Pokemon with a damaging move, all opposing Pokemon get Perish Song. If an affected opposing Pokemon already has Perish Song, its countdown is reduced by 1 instead. During Haunted Field, affected foes are trapped while adjacent to this Pokemon. This effect is blocked by Holy Field and does not trigger from allies.
perishbody.shortDesc: Enemy hit: foes get Perish Song; repeat hits lower the count; Haunted traps.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.desc: Ice Body + Ice Scales + Refrigerate. Contact attackers may be frozen. Hail, snow, and icy fields restore HP; special attacks deal half damage. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and gain power. Retains the component abilities' field effects.

phalanxform.name: Phalanx Form
phalanxform.desc: This Pokemon has Hydra Bond, Friend Guard, and Battle Armor's effects, gains STAB on Steel moves, and cannot be trapped.
phalanxform.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Friend Guard + Battle Armor; Steel STAB; untrappable.

phantombarrage.name: Phantom Barrage
phantombarrage.desc: This Pokemon has Infiltrator, Levitate, and Hydra Bond's effects. Dragon Darts and G-Max Spirit Volley use its higher offensive stat and gain 20% power from Hydra Bond instead of extra hits. Dragon Darts keeps its two-hit pattern; Spirit Volley keeps its full-power hit and weaker follow-up against another foe. In Free-for-All battles, Dragon Darts hits all opposing Pokemon twice.
phantombarrage.shortDesc: Clear Body + Infiltrator + Levitate + Hydra Bond; signature moves gain 20% power.

phantomfist.name: Phantom Fist
phantomfist.desc: Unseen Fist + Self Repair + Shadow Shield + Aftermath. Its moves cannot miss, contact moves bypass Protect, it repairs itself, takes 0.8x attack damage at any HP (0.6x total from super-effective attacks), and damages contact attackers that knock it out.
phantomfist.shortDesc: Unseen Fist + Self Repair + Shadow Shield + Aftermath; moves cannot miss.

pincercrush.name: Pincer Crush
pincercrush.desc: Tough Claws. Once per switch-in, its first Steel-type contact attack to damage a foe lowers the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
pincercrush.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Steel contact hit per entry lowers the foe’s Defense.

plasmaeruption.name: Plasma Eruption
plasmaeruption.desc: Proficient boosts same-type attacks by 1.3x. Contact attackers have Static's chance to be paralyzed and Flame Body's chance to be burned. Fire moves may become Electric, and Electric moves may become Fire (50% chance each), unless the new type would make the target immune. After Burn Up removes Fire typing, Fire moves always become Electric; after Double Shock removes Electric typing, Electric moves always become Fire. Burn Up and Double Shock themselves keep their original type.
plasmaeruption.shortDesc: Proficient + Static + Flame Body; Fire may turn Electric or vice versa (50%). Type loss forces it unless immune.

pollenbloom.name: Pollen Bloom
pollenbloom.desc: This Pokemon has Proficient, Thick Fat and Unaware's effects. At the end of each turn, opposing non-Grass Pokemon take Grass-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Grass immunities; this Pokemon heals the damage dealt by that chip. Only in Free-for-All does Grass type effectiveness scale this chip.
pollenbloom.shortDesc: Proficient + Thick Fat + Unaware; healing Grass chip scales by type in FFA.

pollenengine.name: Pollen Engine
pollenengine.desc: Chlorophyll. Once per turn, successfully hitting a foe with a powder move or damaging Grass move heals itself and adjacent allies by 1/16 maximum HP, or 1/8 in sunlight.
pollenengine.shortDesc: Chlorophyll; Grass or powder hits heal it and its allies, more in sun.

powerdrill.name: Power Drill
powerdrill.desc: This Pokemon's drill moves have 1.5x power.

precision.name: Precision
precision.desc: Super-effective moves used by this Pokemon cannot miss and have an increased critical-hit ratio.
precision.shortDesc: Super-effective moves never miss; boosted critical-hit ratio.

predator.name: Predator
predator.desc: Stat changes this Pokemon receives are inverted, except those from Z-Power effects. If the target has not moved yet or just switched in, this Pokemon's attacks deal 1.3x damage. Attacks deal 2x damage to targets with Neutralization or Royal Decree.
predator.shortDesc: Has Contrary; boosts attacks into slower/new targets; 2x into authority abilities.

pressurekiln.name: Pressure Kiln
pressurekiln.desc: Stores half the actual HP damage from opposing direct moves, up to 1/4 maximum HP. Its next Fire attack dealing opposing HP damage consumes the reservoir and heals the stored amount. Residual, recoil, ally and Substitute-only damage do not fill it. Switching clears storage.
pressurekiln.shortDesc: Stores half foe move HP damage (cap 1/4 max HP); next Fire HP hit consumes it to heal.

primalego.name: Primal Ego
primalego.desc: This Pokemon has Unaware, Proficient, and Ultra Ego's effects. Ultra Ego's combat effects are inactive on Bewitched Woods, Haunted, and Holy Field. Its enhanced-field one-time 1/4 HP pinch recovery is consumed only when it actually restores HP; blocked healing preserves it for a later eligible hit window.
primalego.shortDesc: Unaware + Proficient + Ultra Ego + Mold Breaker.

primalrhythm.name: Primal Rhythm
primalrhythm.desc: Damaging sound moves become physical and use Attack. These moves spare allies. Retains normal sound interactions, including Soundproof and Throat Chop.
primalrhythm.shortDesc: Sound attacks use Attack and spare allies.

primaltactics.name: Primal Tactics
primaltactics.desc: This Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while this Pokemon is Dynamaxed.
primaltactics.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

primevalhunger.name: Primeval Hunger
primevalhunger.desc: Full Accumulation, including Stockpile, automatic releases, weather immunity and Fire/Ice damage protection. Draining attacks that damage a foe's HP inflict Heal Block through the end of the following turn. After the whole move, lower one positive Attack or Sp. Atk stage of each damaged foe, choosing the more boosted stat and Sp. Atk on ties. Never lowers an unboosted stat or grants the user a boost. Substitute-only damage does not trigger these effects; normal stat-drop protections apply.
primevalhunger.shortDesc: Accumulation; draining hits briefly Heal Block and lower a foe's higher positive attacking stage.

primevalhunt.name: Primeval Hunt
primevalhunt.desc: Full Skill Link and Battle Armor. The final scheduled hit of a move with at least three hits is a guaranteed critical hit unless critical-hit immunity prevents it. Earlier hits retain normal critical chances; interruption does not promote an earlier hit.
primevalhunt.shortDesc: Skill Link + Battle Armor; final scheduled hit of 3+ hit moves critically hits.

prismscale.name: Prism Scale
prismscale.desc: Marvel Scale boosts Defense while statused or on supported fields. Oblivious blocks Attract, Captivate, Taunt, and Intimidate's Attack drop. Swift Swim boosts Speed in rain and supported water fields.

prismwings.name: Prism Wings
prismwings.desc: Tinted Lens. Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with a resisted attack raises this Pokemon's Speed by 1 stage.
prismwings.shortDesc: Tinted Lens. Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with a resisted attack raises its Speed by 1 stage.

proficient.name: Proficient
proficient.desc: This Pokemon's STAB moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

protectiveward.name: Protective Ward
protectiveward.desc: This Pokemon has Liquid Voice, Shell Armor, and Water Absorb's effects. It can use Arenite Wall and Aurora Veil regardless of weather or field.
protectiveward.shortDesc: Liquid Voice + Shell Armor + Water Absorb; ignores wall conditions.

pulseblockade.name: Pulse Blockade
pulseblockade.desc: On entry, sets Snowy Mountain Field for 5 turns. While active and effective, prevents other fields from being created or replacing the current field. Auras, natural field expiry, and restoration of an underlying field still work. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use.
pulseblockade.shortDesc: 5-turn Snowy Mountain on entry; blocks other field creation while effective.

pulsebulwark.name: Pulse Bulwark
pulsebulwark.desc: Mr. Mime-Pulse automatically receives Light Screen, Reflect, Dazzling Gleam, and Dark Pulse in that order. On entry, sets Short-Circuit Field for 5 turns. Reflect and Light Screen gain +1 priority. Once per actual entry, successfully creating a new one of these screens cures major status on this Pokemon and its active allies. Ability changes do not reset the cure. Screens retain their normal duration, removal, and bypass rules. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use.
pulsebulwark.shortDesc: 5-turn Short-Circuit; +1-priority screens; first new screen per entry cures active allies' status.

pulseeruption.name: Pulse Eruption
pulseeruption.desc: Camerupt-Pulse automatically receives Eruption, Snarl, Shadow Ball, and Earth Power in that order. Full Sturdy: OHKO moves fail, and direct move damage cannot KO this Pokemon from full HP. On entry, attempts to create or refresh Super-Heated Terrain for 5 turns, respecting normal field restrictions. Skill Swap fails. At Camerupt-Pulse's fixed 1 HP, Sturdy can prevent repeated direct hits; indirect damage and ability bypass remain effective. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use.
pulseeruption.shortDesc: Sturdy; 5-turn Super-Heated field on entry; no Skill Swap.

pulsefiltration.name: Pulse Filtration
pulsefiltration.desc: Water- and Poison-type moves used by another Pokemon do not affect this Pokemon and instead restore 1/4 of its maximum HP. This immunity still works at full HP or when healing is blocked. Mold Breaker and other applicable ability-ignoring effects bypass it. On entry, summons Murkwater Surface for 5 turns, subject to field-generation blockers. It provides no ability-based residual healing. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use.
pulsefiltration.shortDesc: 5-turn Murkwater Surface on entry; absorbs Water/Poison moves to heal 1/4 max HP.

pulsetriad.name: Pulse Triad
pulsetriad.desc: Hydra Bond + Levitate + Clear Body. On entry, sets Factory Field for 5 turns. Eligible single-target attacks hit three times, it is ungrounded, and opponents cannot lower its stats. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Magnezone-Pulse automatically receives Flash Cannon, Discharge, Recover, and Autotomize in that order.
pulsetriad.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Levitate + Clear Body; 5-turn Factory Field on entry.

pulsewaste.name: Pulse Waste
pulsewaste.desc: On entry, summons Murkwater Surface for 5 turns, subject to field-generation blockers. This Pokemon has Protean, Poison Touch, and Regenerator's effects. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use.
pulsewaste.shortDesc: Protean + Poison Touch + Regenerator; 5-turn Murkwater Surface on entry.

punchfiend.name: Punch Fiend
punchfiend.desc: This Pokemon has Iron Fist, Inner Focus, and Unseen Fist's effects.
punchfiend.shortDesc: Iron Fist + Inner Focus + Unseen Fist.

purifyingfrost.name: Purifying Frost
purifyingfrost.desc: On switch-in, cures status conditions from this Pokemon and its active allies. Once per switch-in, after its first Ice-type move, it sets Safeguard on its side for 5 turns, even if that move misses or fails.
purifyingfrost.shortDesc: Cures its side's active Pokemon on entry; first Ice move sets 5-turn Safeguard.

quarrycannon.name: Quarry Cannon
quarrycannon.desc: Solid Rock, including this server's 20% damage reduction and additional 25% reduction against super-effective hits. Rock Blast always hits five times unless interrupted. Does not alter Z/Max moves or Rock Wrecker recharge rules.
quarrycannon.shortDesc: Solid Rock; Rock Blast always hits five times.

queensguard.name: Queen's Guard
queensguard.desc: This Pokemon has Contrary, Shed Skin, Intimidate, Infiltrator, and Proficient's effects. Its stat changes are reversed, it lowers opposing Attack on entry, and Shed Skin can clear ailments and restore HP. Its moves bypass substitutes and opposing screens, and attacks matching its type have 1.3x power.
queensguard.shortDesc: Contrary + Shed Skin + Intimidate + Infiltrator + Proficient.

quillreservoir.name: Quill Reservoir
quillreservoir.desc: Water Absorb, including its field effects. Absorbing a Water move primes its next landed damaging Poison move to poison the target. The charge does not stack; normal status immunities apply.
quillreservoir.shortDesc: Water Absorb; the next Poison hit after absorbing Water poisons its foe.

ragingbeast.name: Raging Beast
ragingbeast.desc: This Pokemon has Guts and Mold Breaker's effects.

ragingcurrent.name: Raging Current
ragingcurrent.desc: Swift Swim + Damp + Dry Skin + Stamina + Proficient. Water Veil and its burn immunity are removed.
ragingcurrent.shortDesc: Swift Swim + Damp + Dry Skin + Stamina + Proficient.

ragingfists.name: Raging Fists
ragingfists.desc: Hydra Bond, Normal/Fighting Ghost-immunity bypass, and damaging moves cannot miss. Retains Hydra Bond's Free-for-All targeting and Dragon's Den power bonus, without an extra multi-hit power multiplier. Does not grant Fighting Fiend's sleep immunity or Multiscale, or Scrappy's Intimidate immunity. Status moves retain their normal accuracy.
ragingfists.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Scrappy; Normal/Fighting hits Ghosts; damaging moves cannot miss.

ragingoverlord.name: Raging Overlord
ragingoverlord.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed. This Pokemon has Raging Storm and Supreme Overlord's effects.

ragingstorm.name: Raging Storm
ragingstorm.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed. This Pokemon has Mold Breaker and Battle Armor. Its attacks ignore Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, and defensive stat boosts. If this Pokemon gets a KO, it damages remaining foes for 60% of the last damage in multi battles, or raises Attack by 1 if there is no valid target or no damage is dealt. Magic Guard users do not take this damage.
ragingstorm.shortDesc: Mold Breaker + Battle Armor; Cannot be suppressed; attacks ignore screens/defensive boosts; KO bonus.

railguncircuit.name: Railgun Circuit
railguncircuit.desc: Lightning Rod; never misses; boosts Electric attacks. Redirects and absorbs Electric moves, raising Attack and Special Attack. Electric moves are strengthened; Ground damage is reduced on Electric Terrain.
railguncircuit.shortDesc: Lightning Rod; never misses; boosts Electric attacks.

railsight.name: Rail Sight
railsight.desc: Full Stalwart, including its local field effects. Once per switch-in, surviving a whole opposing damaging move that hits HP stores a non-stacking 1.5x boost for the next Electric attack. Consumed when that attack executes, including misses, Protect or immunity; charge-only and interrupted turns do not consume it. Switching clears it. Does not skip Electro Shot charging, grant an extra Sp. Atk boost or ignore screens.
railsight.shortDesc: Stalwart; once/entry after surviving an opposing HP hit, next Electric attack has 1.5x power.

rainsovereign.name: Rain Sovereign
rainsovereign.desc: On entry, this Pokemon sets Rain for 8 turns. Its Electric-, Water-, and Flying-type moves receive STAB. Each turn, non-immune foes take Water damage equal to 1/16 max HP. Only in Free-for-All does Water type effectiveness scale this chip.
rainsovereign.shortDesc: Drizzle; 8-turn Rain; Electric/Water/Flying STAB; Water chip scales by type in FFA.

raisedquills.name: Raised Quills
raisedquills.desc: Successfully using a status move primes one non-stacking charge that poisons the next opposing contact attacker, subject to normal status immunities.
raisedquills.shortDesc: Using a status move primes the next contact attacker to be poisoned.

rapidresponse.name: Rapid Response
rapidresponse.desc: On this Pokemon's first active turn, its Speed is 1.5x and its Sp. Atk is 1.2x.
rapidresponse.shortDesc: First active turn: 1.5x Spe and 1.2x Sp. Atk.

razorcurrent.name: Razor Current
razorcurrent.desc: Drizzle + Strong Jaw + Speed Boost. Summons rain, strengthens biting moves, and raises Speed each turn. Steelworker is removed.

razorreach.name: Razor Reach
razorreach.desc: Full Sharpness + Long Reach. Slicing moves have 1.5x power (except on Cold Eclipse), all attacks are non-contact, and entry grants +1 accuracy. Retains local Long Reach critical-hit and field effects: 0.9x move accuracy on Rocky/Grassy Field and 1.5x power on Mountain/Snowy Mountain. Replaces the former 1.3x slicing boost; no stacking with it.
razorreach.shortDesc: Sharpness + full local Long Reach; all attacks non-contact; +1 accuracy on entry.

reapersgrip.name: Reaper's Grip
reapersgrip.desc: Unaware + Dark Aura + Self Sufficient; creates Haunted Field. Iron Fist no longer strengthens punching moves.
reapersgrip.shortDesc: Unaware + Dark Aura + Self Sufficient; creates Haunted Field.

rebornflower.name: Reborn Flower
rebornflower.desc: This Pokemon has Invigorate and Flower Veil's effects. It permanently becomes Florges-Reborn when it enters battle.
rebornflower.shortDesc: Invigorate + Flower Veil; permanently becomes Florges-Reborn on entry.

rechargerelay.name: Recharge Relay
rechargerelay.desc: Battery, including its existing Electric Terrain effect. Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's maximum HP.
rechargerelay.shortDesc: Battery, including its existing Electric Terrain effect. Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's HP.

reflector.name: Reflector
reflector.desc: On entry, copies the active foe's types and adds them to this Pokemon's typing. Matching attacks deal half damage unless this Pokemon is immune. Reflect Type refreshes the copied types. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.
reflector.shortDesc: Copies foe types; adds them to its typing; matching attacks deal 0.5x unless immune.

reinflate.name: Reinflate
reinflate.desc: Once per turn, after this Pokemon finishes a sound-based damaging move that deals actual HP damage to an opponent, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP if it remains active and survives. All hits and spread targets share one activation. Substitute-only, ally, self, delayed, missed, protected and immune damage do not qualify. Status moves do not qualify. Heal Block prevents recovery, and ability suppression disables this effect. Ability changes do not refresh the turn's activation.
reinflate.shortDesc: Once per turn, after a sound move damages a foe's HP, restores 1/8 max HP.

relentlesshunt.name: Relentless Hunt
relentlesshunt.desc: This Pokemon has Levitate. Its moves with 60 or less Base Power gain +1 priority. In Fairy Tale, Big Top, Dragon's Den, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, or Cold Eclipse, its damaging moves deal 2x damage. In Desert, Rocky, Forest, Burning, Superheated, Ashen Beach, Water Surface, Cave, Starlight Arena, or New World, its damaging moves deal 1.5x damage.
relentlesshunt.shortDesc: Levitate; moves <=60 BP gain +1 priority; boosted fields give 1.5x or 2x damage.

relentlesslink.name: Relentless Link
relentlesslink.desc: Skill Link + Mold Breaker + Power Drill. Drill and horn moves gain Power Drill effects. Guts and Battle Armor are removed.
relentlesslink.shortDesc: Skill Link + Mold Breaker + Power Drill.

relicarmor.name: Relic Armor
relicarmor.desc: In Desert, Fairy Tale, Cave, Crystal Cavern, New World, or Volcanic Field, this Pokemon's Defense and Special Defense rise by 1. Its Rock typing does not add weaknesses to Fighting, Ground, Steel, Water, or Grass. It cannot be critically hit, takes 0.8x damage from attacks, and has Self Sufficient's effects. After an opposing Pokemon lowers one of its stats, its Defense and Special Defense rise by 1.
relicarmor.shortDesc: Rock weaknesses removed; field +1 Def/SpD; no crits; 0.8x damage; Self Sufficient.

relicbeam.name: Relic Beam
relicbeam.desc: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk becomes equal to its Defense, and Special Attack stat stages use Defense stages instead. Beam moves and moves boosted by Mega Launcher have 1.5x power.
relicbeam.shortDesc: SpA equals Defense using Def stages; beam/Mega Launcher moves have 1.5x power.

relicinstinct.name: Relic Instinct
relicinstinct.desc: Above 50% HP, this Pokemon's moves ignore opposing Abilities. At 50% HP or less, it takes 0.75x damage from attacks, cannot be critically hit, restores 1/16 max HP each turn, and its Attack and Special Attack are halved. Once at 25% HP or less, it heals 25% max HP, clears negative stat stages, and lowers its Defense and Special Defense by 2.
relicinstinct.shortDesc: >50%: ignores Abilities. <=50%: defensive mode; <=25%: one pinch heal.

relicmishap.name: Relic Mishap
relicmishap.desc: This Pokemon takes 0.9x damage from attacks and has Self Sufficient, Water Absorb, and Volt Absorb. It restores 1/16 max HP each turn and is immune to Sandstorm and Hail damage. During Sandstorm, its Special Defense is multiplied by 1.5. During Hail or Snow, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
relicmishap.shortDesc: 0.9x damage; Self Sufficient; Water/Volt Absorb; Sand +SpD; Hail/Snow +Def.

requiem.name: Requiem
requiem.desc: This Pokemon has Cursed Body's effect. Its first direct damaging interaction with each opposing Pokemon applies Perish Song to that foe. The mark clears when the foe switches out. Whenever an opposing Pokemon faints, this Pokemon restores 1/4 max HP. When this Pokemon faints, it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns. This Ability cannot be suppressed.
requiem.shortDesc: Cursed Body; first hit marks foes with Perish Song; foe KO heals 1/4; faint sets Haunted.

reservoir.name: Reservoir
reservoir.desc: Has Water Absorb, Gluttony, and Damp's full effects. Water-type moves from other Pokemon heal 1/4 maximum HP instead of hitting; qualifying water fields heal 1/16 each turn. Berries normally eaten at 1/4 HP activate at 1/2 HP. Prevents Explosion, Self-Destruct, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, and Aftermath damage. Halves the attacking stat used by incoming Fire-type moves, and prevents Damp's ignition moves on Corrosive Mist Field.

resonanceforce.name: Resonance Force
resonanceforce.desc: Sound-based moves used by this Pokemon's side deal 1.5x damage. This Pokemon's side is immune to its own damaging sound-based moves. Sound-based moves used by this Pokemon use its higher offensive stat.
resonanceforce.shortDesc: Side sound moves 1.5x; allies avoid own sound damage; sound uses higher offense.

resonantblade.name: Resonant Blade
resonantblade.desc: Slicing moves ignore damage reduction from Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Atlantis Wall and Arenite Wall. Does not bypass Substitute.
resonantblade.shortDesc: Slicing moves bypass screens and walls, but not Substitute.

restorativechime.name: Restorative Chime
restorativechime.desc: Once per stay, a healing move that actually restores HP also cures the healed recipient's major status; Rest is excluded. Wish checks and consumes the originating entry's cure only when it heals its eventual recipient. Successful sound moves heal this Pokemon by 1/8 maximum HP once per turn.
restorativechime.shortDesc: Healing moves cure a healed recipient once per stay (not Rest); successful sound moves heal 1/8 per turn.

resuscitation.name: Resuscitation
resuscitation.desc: When Parasect revives as Parasect-Parasite, its status, stat stages, and volatile effects are cleared and it returns to full HP. Afterward, this Ability has Self Repair and Magic Guard's effects.
resuscitation.shortDesc: Self Repair + Magic Guard; Revival fully resets battle effects.

riftdancer.name: Rift Dancer
riftdancer.desc: Chlorophyll + Dancer + Overgrow. Once per battle, the first damaging hit that would cross below half HP stops at half HP, then immediately heals 25% max HP. Once per battle, its first activation attempts to create a full Stage 1 Flower Garden for 5 turns, respecting protected fields. Existing gardens are not advanced or refreshed; this first attempt spends the use even if creation is blocked. Each actual stage gained adds 1 remaining turn to this garden, including re-growth; lowering a stage or trying to grow at maximum adds nothing. The garden grows one stage at each turn end without requiring weather and keeps this property after the user switches out.
riftdancer.shortDesc: Chlorophyll + Dancer + Overgrow; growing Garden; once/battle half-HP guard + 25% heal.

rifteater.name: Rift Eater
rifteater.desc: Combines Accumulation and Sand Stream. Once per battle, the first damaging hit that would cross below half HP stops at half HP, activates its awakening, then immediately heals 25% max HP. Its fourth move is always Sludge Wave. At half HP or less, it creates Desert Field, becomes Ground/Fire, and changes its fourth move to Heat Wave. If sandstorm has ended, it summons it again at that moment.
rifteater.shortDesc: Accumulation + Sand Stream; at half HP: Desert Field, Ground/Fire, Sludge Wave becomes Heat Wave, restores sand.

rimebreaker.name: Rimebreaker
rimebreaker.desc: Full Refrigerate, including its field boosts only for converted moves. Once per turn, an Ice move dealing opposing HP damage removes this side's Stealth Rock and one Spikes layer. Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web remain. Natural Ice moves receive no extra ability damage boost.
rimebreaker.shortDesc: Refrigerate; Ice HP hits clear own Stealth Rock and one Spikes layer once per turn.

rimeclaw.name: Rime Claw
rimeclaw.desc: Tough Claws. The first Ice-type contact attack to damage a foe each switch-in removes one opposing screen after damage.
rimeclaw.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Ice contact hit per entry breaks a screen.

rimeknuckle.name: Rime Knuckle
rimeknuckle.desc: Filter + Iron Fist + Ice Body. Damaging moves have a 40% chance to cause frostbite (80% on Icy Field). KOs restore 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 against Mega, G-Max, Terastallized, Stellar or Z-Move item targets. Ice Body adds a 30% chance to frostbite contact attackers, hail immunity, and healing in hail/snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse fields. Healing is 1/16 max HP, or 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse.
rimeknuckle.shortDesc: Iron Fist + Filter + Ice Body; frostbite chance; KO healing.

rimeplate.name: Rimeplate
rimeplate.desc: Takes 75% less damage from hits after the first hit of a multi-hit attack. The first hit and separate attacks deal normal damage. Does not change Glaive Rush's effects.
rimeplate.shortDesc: Later hits of a multi-hit move deal 75% less damage.

ringmaster.name: Ringmaster
ringmaster.desc: Tough Claws. Its first damaging Dark hit against a surviving foe each entry attempts to inflict Taunt for 2 turns. Normal Taunt immunities apply; no Fake Out requirement.
ringmaster.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Dark hit each entry Taunts the foe for 2 turns.

riotamp.name: Riot Amp
riotamp.desc: This Pokemon has Galvanize, Resonance Force, and Volt Absorb's effects.

riptideclaws.name: Riptide Claws
riptideclaws.desc: This Pokemon has Swift Swim, Tough Claws, Shell Armor, and Mold Breaker's effects.
riptideclaws.shortDesc: Swift Swim + Tough Claws + Shell Armor + Mold Breaker.

rivershell.name: River Shell
rivershell.desc: Shell Armor, including this server's damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Shell Smash does not lower its Defense, but still lowers its Sp. Def.
rivershell.shortDesc: Shell Armor; Shell Smash keeps Defense but still lowers Sp. Def.

rootediron.name: Rooted Iron
rootediron.desc: Stamina. At the end of turns in which this Pokemon did not attempt a damaging move, it restores 1/16 maximum HP. Also retains this server's Stamina on-hit Defense gain and healing.
rootediron.shortDesc: Stamina; heals 1/16 HP on turns when it does not attack.

rootrenewal.name: Root Renewal
rootrenewal.desc: Regenerator. Switching out restores 1/3 maximum HP and cures one adjacent active ally's major status condition.
rootrenewal.shortDesc: Regenerator. Switching out restores 1/3 HP and cures one adjacent active ally's major status condition.

roughscale.name: Rough Scale
roughscale.desc: This Pokemon has Rough Skin and Tough Claws' effects.

royalarmament.name: Royal Armament
royalarmament.desc: This Pokemon gains STAB on Steel-type moves and has Power Drill's effects.

royaldecree.name: Royal Decree
royaldecree.desc: On switch-in, all active Pokemon's stat stages are reset to 0, except Pokemon on a side protected by Safeguard, and Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil are removed from both sides. While this Pokemon is active, Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil cannot be created, enemy stat boosts fail, enemy-caused stat drops fail, and charge moves fire immediately. This Pokemon's own self-inflicted stat drops still work. Neutralization disables these Royal Decree effects while active. If Neutralization is already active on entry, the stat and screen reset does not happen; it does not happen later when Neutralization leaves.
royaldecree.shortDesc: Haze/screen clear; Safeguard blocks reset; blocks setup/screens; skips charge turns.

royalhive.name: Royal Hive
royalhive.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon starts in Attack Stance and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. After it uses a status move, it changes to Defense Stance, lowering its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage and raising its Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. After it uses a damaging move while in Defense Stance, it changes back to Attack Stance, lowering its Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage and raising its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. While in Defense Stance, it restores 1/16 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.
royalhive.shortDesc: Starts +1 Atk/SpA; status moves swap to +1 Def/SpD and heal 1/16; attacks swap back.

royalscales.name: Royal Scales
royalscales.desc: Prism Scale, Dragonize, and Self Sufficient. Status or Prism Scale's supported fields boost Defense by 1.5x. Blocks Attract, Captivate, Taunt, and Intimidate's Attack drop. Speed doubles in rain and Swift Swim's supported fields. Normal moves become Dragon and gain Dragonize's power boost. Restores 1/16 of this Pokemon's maximum HP at the end of each turn and prevents Sandstorm and Hail damage.
royalscales.shortDesc: Prism Scale + Dragonize + Self Sufficient; heals 1/16 each turn; immune to Sandstorm and Hail.

royalsun.name: Royal Sun
royalsun.desc: Drought + Supreme Overlord + Unnerve + Flame Body. Summons sun for the usual Drought duration. Move power gains 10% per fainted ally; at 2 fallen allies, gains Infiltrator; at 4, flinch immunity; at 5, Magic Guard and a one-time +1 Attack and Special Attack. Opponents cannot eat Berries or use field seeds. Contact has a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic Field. On Cold Eclipse, lowers opposing Speed by 1 on entry (blocked by Substitute), raises its Defense and Special Defense by 1, and cannot burn through contact.
royalsun.shortDesc: Drought + Supreme Overlord + Unnerve + Flame Body.

royalvoice.name: Royal Voice
royalvoice.desc: Pixilate + Queenly Majesty + Dream Sickness. Normal moves become Fairy and receive Pixilate power boosts. Blocks opposing priority moves targeting its side. Includes Telepathy and its field effects, 1/16 end-turn healing for itself and allies, and a once-per-switch-in rescue that leaves an ally at 1 HP and costs the holder 1/4 max HP.

ruinjaw.name: Ruin Jaw
ruinjaw.desc: This Pokemon has Strong Jaw and Earth Eater's effects.

sacredbond.name: Sacred Bond
sacredbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Magma Armor, Intimidate, and Flash Fire. Arcanine-Battle-Bond's Extreme Speed has 1.5x power and always critically hits.
sacredbond.shortDesc: Battle Bond + Magma Armor + Intimidate + Flash Fire; Extreme Speed is 1.5x power and always critical.

sacrededge.name: Sacred Edge
sacrededge.desc: This Pokemon has Sharpness, Dual Wield, and Sworn Duty's effects. Its slicing moves have 1.5x power. When Dual Wield applies to one of those slicing moves, the first hit keeps the 1.5x Sharpness boost and the second hit has 20% of the move's unboosted power. On switch-in or Mega Evolution, it heals its ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale Field.

sacredpower.name: Sacred Power
sacredpower.desc: Duskilate + Insomnia + Magic Guard. Adaptability is removed.

safeharbor.name: Safe Harbor
safeharbor.desc: Ice Body + Water Absorb + Hydration. Absorbs Water attacks, heals under icy weather/fields, and cures status in rain or water fields. Ice attacks are not absorbed.

saltbastion.name: Salt Bastion
saltbastion.desc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves this Pokemon from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.
saltbastion.shortDesc: Sturdy. When Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.

saltcrust.name: Salt Crust
saltcrust.desc: Clear Body. While Defense is positively boosted, opponents cannot remove its held item. Does not prevent its boosts being reset, stolen or ignored.
saltcrust.shortDesc: Clear Body; while Defense is boosted, its held item cannot be removed.

sandsovereign.name: Sand Sovereign
sandsovereign.desc: On entry, this Pokemon sets Sandstorm for 8 turns. It has Dauntless Shield and Solid Rock. Arenite Wall lasts 5 turns, or 8 turns when extended. Each turn, non-immune foes take Rock damage equal to 1/16 max HP. Only in Free-for-All does Rock type effectiveness scale this chip.
sandsovereign.shortDesc: Sand Stream + Dauntless Shield + Solid Rock; 8-turn Sand; Rock chip scales by type in FFA.

sandstream.name: Sand Stream
sandstream.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.
sandstream.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

sapsipper.name: Sap Sipper
sapsipper.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move. Grass moves from an ally also raise both stats. Grassy and Forest fields restore HP each turn.
sapsipper.shortDesc: Grass moves raise Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; Grass immunity.

savageresolve.name: Savage Resolve
savageresolve.desc: Full Guts: Attack is multiplied by 1.5 while statused, and burn does not halve physical damage. Once per actual entry, after surviving an entire opposing damaging move that dealt actual HP damage while this Pokemon was already statused, it gains one Speed stage if still active. Status inflicted after a hit does not make that hit qualify. All hits and opponents share one activation. Substitute-only, ally, self, residual and delayed damage do not qualify. Switching resets usage; ability replacement and suppression do not. Suppression disables the effect. The Speed boost is an ordinary stat stage and does not remove paralysis's Speed penalty.
savageresolve.shortDesc: Guts; once per entry, surviving a foe's HP-damaging attack while statused gives +1 Speed.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: This Pokemon has Wind Rider, Steelworker, and Stakeout's effects.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: This Pokemon has Overcoat, Big Pecks, and Regenerator's effects.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.desc: A level 20 or higher Wishiwashi changes to School Form above 1/4 maximum HP. Underwater and Midnight Zone force School Form; Water Surface and Murkwater force it while grounded. It returns to Solo Form at or below 1/4 maximum HP otherwise. While in School Form, it has Hydra Bond, Self Repair, and Mold Breaker's effects.
schooling.shortDesc: Changes form by HP and water terrain; School: Hydra Bond + Self Repair + Mold Breaker.

scorchsweep.name: Scorch Sweep
scorchsweep.desc: Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with a recoil move clears entry hazards from its side. The attack still deals normal recoil.
scorchsweep.shortDesc: Once per entry, recoil-move damage clears its side’s hazards.

scrapbreaker.name: Scrapbreaker
scrapbreaker.desc: Full Mold Breaker. A connecting Gigaton Hammer removes the target side's Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil before damage. Actual opposing HP damage also grounds the target as Smack Down; Substitute-only damage does not ground it. Normal accuracy, protection and consecutive-use restrictions remain.
scrapbreaker.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; Gigaton Hammer breaks screens and grounds foes it damages.

seablessing.name: Sea Blessing
seablessing.desc: This Pokemon's Defense and Special Defense are 1.5x. On entry, it and adjacent allies heal 1/4 max HP, and it gains Aqua Ring. It has Water Veil and Rain Dish.
seablessing.shortDesc: Water Veil + Rain Dish; 1.5x Def/SpD; entry heals self/allies 1/4.

seafiend.name: Sea Fiend
seafiend.desc: This Pokemon has Toxic Debris and Water Bubble's effects.

searescuer.name: Sea Rescuer
searescuer.desc: Once per entry, the first Roost that actually restores HP lets the trainer choose a replacement after healing, if one is available. Switching abilities does not refresh this effect.
searescuer.shortDesc: Once per entry, Roost healing lets it switch out.

seasonalstride.name: Seasonal Stride
seasonalstride.desc: Normal moves become this Pokemon's primary type and have 1.2x power. Kicking moves have 1.4x power. It has Chlorophyll and changes forme with weather: Spring in rain, Summer in sun, Autumn in sand, Winter in snow.
seasonalstride.shortDesc: Chlorophyll; Normal -> primary type 1.2x; kicks 1.4x; weather forms.

secondbrew.name: Second Brew
secondbrew.desc: Once per turn, when this Pokemon receives draining-move healing, it also restores 1/8 of the lowest-HP adjacent ally's maximum HP.
secondbrew.shortDesc: Once per turn, when it receives draining-move healing, it also restores 1/8 of the lowest-HP adjacent ally's HP.

secondwind.name: Second Wind
secondwind.desc: The first otherwise lethal attack has a 50% chance to leave this Pokemon at 1 HP. This Ability rolls only once per battle, even if the roll fails or this Pokemon switches out.
secondwind.shortDesc: 50% chance to survive the first lethal attack at 1 HP; one roll per battle.

selfrepair.name: Self Repair
selfrepair.desc: This Pokemon has Self Sufficient and Natural Cure's effects.

selfsufficient.name: Self Sufficient
selfsufficient.desc: Restores 1/16 of this Pokemon's maximum HP at the end of each turn and is immune to Sandstorm and Hail damage.
selfsufficient.shortDesc: Heals 1/16 each turn; immune to Sandstorm and Hail.

setpiece.name: Set Piece
setpiece.desc: Successfully using Court Change or damaging a target with Feint primes its next Fire attack to gain +1 priority and never miss. One non-stacking charge; used when the attack is attempted, and cleared on switching. Protect and immunities still work.
setpiece.shortDesc: Court Change or Feint charges the next Fire attack with +1 priority and perfect accuracy.

seviischooling.name: Sevii Schooling
seviischooling.desc: Changes Wishiwashi into its Ghost-type Sevii form, or Ghost/Dragon Sevii Schooling form at level 20 or higher above 1/4 maximum HP. Underwater and Midnight Zone force School Form; Water Surface and Murkwater force it while grounded. The School Form has Hydra Bond, Self Repair, and Mold Breaker's effects.
seviischooling.shortDesc: Schooling; Changes Wishiwashi to Sevii form; School: Hydra Bond + Self Repair + Mold Breaker.

shadowbond.name: Shadow Bond
shadowbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Proficient and Infiltrator. Ash-Greninja's Water Shuriken hits three times at 30 base power per hit and always critically hits.
shadowbond.shortDesc: Battle Bond + Proficient + Infiltrator; Water Shuriken is 3 hits at 30 power, always critical.

shadowcurrent.name: Shadow Current
shadowcurrent.desc: This Pokemon has Protean, Technician, Infiltrator, and Anticipation's effects. Before using a move, it becomes that move's type.

shadowfeint.name: Shadow Feint
shadowfeint.desc: Ordinary damaging Dark moves penetrate normal protection at one-third damage, without secondary effects through protection. Does not remove Protect, bypass Max Guard, or alter Z/Max move protection rules.
shadowfeint.shortDesc: Dark attacks pierce Protect at one-third power, without secondary effects.

shadowshield.name: Shadow Shield
shadowshield.desc: Takes 0.8x damage from attacks at any HP. Super-effective attacks deal a further 0.75x damage (0.6x total). These reductions are not bypassed by Mold Breaker or ability-ignoring moves, but ability suppression disables them. Does not reduce indirect damage. Retains hail immunity on Cold Eclipse.
shadowshield.shortDesc: Takes 0.8x attack damage at any HP; super-effective hits deal 0.6x total.

shattercrust.name: Shattercrust
shattercrust.desc: Full Crumbling Shell: physical HP hits set Stealth Rock on the attacker's side if absent (an allied attacker instead selects the opposing side), except on Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface and Swamp. Additionally, the first opposing physical HP hit each stay deals half damage; if this Pokemon survives it, adds one Spikes layer to the attacker's side.
shattercrust.shortDesc: Crumbling Shell; first foe physical HP hit each stay deals half damage and scatters Spikes if survived.

shellcracker.name: Shellcracker
shellcracker.desc: Crabhammer has 100% base accuracy and always critically hits, unless critical hits are prevented.
shellcracker.shortDesc: Crabhammer has 100% base accuracy and always critically hits, unless critical hits are prevented.

shieldsdown.name: Shields Down
shieldsdown.desc: If this Pokemon is a Minior, it changes to its Core forme if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, and changes to Meteor Form if it has more than 1/2 its maximum HP. This check is done on switch-in and at the end of each turn. While in its Meteor Form, it cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. This Pokemon also has Shell Armor, Self Repair, and Crumbling Shell's effects.
shieldsdown.shortDesc: Shell Armor + Self Repair + Crumbling Shell; Form changes at 1/2 HP.

siegelauncher.name: Siege Launcher
siegelauncher.desc: This Pokemon has Water Barrage, Mega Launcher, Self Sufficient, and Stalwart's effects. Moves boosted by Mega Launcher are used twice through Dual Wield; the second hit deals 15% of the move's unboosted power.
siegelauncher.shortDesc: Proficient; Water Barrage + Mega Launcher + Self Sufficient + Stalwart; boosted moves add 15% hit.

silkendecoy.name: Silken Decoy
silkendecoy.desc: Mega Ariados spins a persistent cocoon, renewed when another Pokemon faints. It blocks status moves and status conditions while intact, and absorbs one damaging move including all its hits and secondary effects. Also has Insomnia, Self Sufficient, and Swarm.
silkendecoy.shortDesc: Insomnia + Self Sufficient + Swarm; Cocoon blocks a move, status and secondaries.

silkshuriken.name: Silk Shuriken
silkshuriken.desc: Water Shuriken becomes Bug-type and hits exactly three times at 20 base power per hit, retaining its priority. Does not alter Z/Max moves.
silkshuriken.shortDesc: Water Shuriken becomes Bug-type: three hits, 20 power each. Priority unchanged.

silksights.name: Silk Sights
silksights.desc: Compound Eyes. Electric attacks ignore positive defensive stat stages against foes whose Speed is lowered. Full local Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus; shared accuracy entry rewards apply once.
silksights.shortDesc: Compound Eyes + Keen Eye; Electric moves ignore defense boosts on foes with lowered Speed.

silkward.name: Silk Ward
silkward.desc: Once per switch-in, the first super-effective damaging hit against this Pokemon deals half damage. It does not set weather.
silkward.shortDesc: First super-effective hit each switch-in deals half damage.

sinisterblaze.name: Sinister Blaze
sinisterblaze.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed, copied, or transferred. This Pokemon is burned on switch-in, even through Misty Terrain, and its burn can overwrite other status conditions. In Fairy Tale, Starlight Arena, New World, Burning Field, Volcanic Field, Superheated Field, or Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Special Defense rise by 1 stage on entry. Its burn damage becomes healing; foes take 1/8 max HP each turn, or 1/4 if already burned. It does not heal from this generated damage, but heals from real burn damage dealt to foes. Its physical attacks are not weakened by burn. It is immune to hail and sandstorm damage and counts as Ice type in hail, snow, and ice fields, except for Abysseon and Divineon.
sinisterblaze.shortDesc: Burn heals user; foes take 1/8, or 1/4 if burned; no burn penalty; hail/sand immune.

sirius.name: Sirius
sirius.desc: Apex Venom + Black Viper. Retains Apex Venom, Dragon-type Poison Fang, +1 accuracy on entry and 1.5x tail power. Its first tail hit against a foe each entry also badly poisons it, subject to status immunities.
sirius.shortDesc: Apex Venom + Black Viper; first tail hit each entry badly poisons.

skywarden.name: Skywarden
skywarden.desc: After successfully using Defog, creates Mist for its team for 5 turns. The Mist is applied after Defog removes effects; an existing longer Mist is not shortened.
skywarden.shortDesc: Defog sets 5-turn Mist for its side.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.desc: Has Levitate's full effect. Once per switch-in, its first Flying-type attack to damage a foe sets Tailwind on its side for 3 turns. If Tailwind is already active, its duration is refreshed to 3 turns. Full local Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus; shared accuracy entry rewards apply once.
slipstream.shortDesc: Levitate + Keen Eye; first landed Flying attack each switch-in sets 3-turn Tailwind.

slowclamp.name: Slow Clamp
slowclamp.desc: Shell Armor + Own Tempo + Analytic + Sweet Veil. Prevents critical hits and confusion, boosts attacks used after other active Pokemon move, and protects this Pokemon and allies from sleep.
slowclamp.shortDesc: Shell Armor + Own Tempo + Analytic + Sweet Veil.

smolderingshroud.name: Smoldering Shroud
smolderingshroud.desc: Has White Smoke's full effect: prevents stat drops from other Pokemon, and raises Attack and Sp. Atk on entry on Volcanic Field. The first foe-caused stat drop it prevents each switch-in also raises its Sp. Atk by one stage.
smolderingshroud.shortDesc: White Smoke; first blocked foe stat drop each switch-in raises Sp. Atk by 1.

snowpack.name: Snowpack
snowpack.desc: Thick Fat + Ice Body + Tough Claws. Includes reduced Fire/Ice damage, contact-move power, weather/field healing, and this server's Ice Body contact-freeze chance.
snowpack.shortDesc: Thick Fat + Ice Body + Tough Claws.

snowwarning.name: Snow Warning
snowwarning.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.
snowwarning.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

soaringspirit.name: Soaring Spirit
soaringspirit.desc: This Pokemon has Wind Power and Self Sufficient's effects.

solarbloom.name: Solar Bloom
solarbloom.desc: If sun is active, this Pokemon transforms into Cherrim-Sunshine and restores 1/8 of its maximum HP. While sun is active, its Speed is doubled.
solarbloom.shortDesc: In sun: becomes Sunshine, heals 1/8, and has doubled Speed.

solarbud.name: Solar Bud
solarbud.desc: Once per entry, finishing a turn in effective sun stores one bud. The next Grass attack dealing HP damage to a foe consumes it to cure status and restore 1/8 maximum HP.
solarbud.shortDesc: Once/entry: sun stores a bud; Grass HP damage spends it to cure status/heal 1/8.

solarhydra.name: Solar Hydra
solarhydra.desc: Hydra Bond + Grassy Surge + Solar Power + Solar Bud. Once per entry, finishing a turn in effective sun stores a bud; the next Grass attack dealing opposing HP damage consumes it to cure status and heal 1/8 maximum HP. Solar Power's HP cost and field effects remain. No Self Repair.
solarhydra.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Grassy Surge + Solar Power + one sun-charged Solar Bud per entry.

solaridol.name: Solar Idol
solaridol.desc: This Pokemon has Levitate's Ground immunity. Its Fire-type moves have 1.5x power, its Attack is 1.5x during sun, and Grass-type attacks are resisted.
solaridol.shortDesc: Levitate; Fire power 1.5x; Attack 1.5x in sun; resists Grass.

solarrecharge.name: Solar Recharge
solarrecharge.desc: This Pokemon's Fire-type moves have STAB. It is immune to Fire-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP when hit by one. In Sun, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.
solarrecharge.shortDesc: Fire STAB; Fire immunity heals 1/4; heals 1/8 each turn in Sun.

solarrush.name: Solar Rush
solarrush.desc: This Pokemon has Sand Rush and Chlorophyll's effects.

solartrap.name: Solar Trap
solartrap.desc: Accumulation + Digestive Sap + Liquid Ooze. Poison attacks heal 1/3 of actual damage dealt to foes, capped at 1/8 max HP per turn; draining moves used on this Pokemon hurt the user instead.

soothingpresence.name: Soothing Presence
soothingpresence.desc: Combines Friend Guard and Aroma Veil. Other allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not reduce the holder's damage taken. The holder and its allies are protected from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
soothingpresence.shortDesc: Friend Guard; Other allies take 25% less attack damage. Holder and allies have Aroma Veil protection.

soulcremation.name: Soul Cremation
soulcremation.desc: Soul Siphon + Soul Pyre + Malice Well. Malice Well includes full Flame Body. Once per entry, the first executed opposing damaging move targeting this Pokemon grants +1 Sp. Atk after the entire move resolves if it is still active and alive, even through Protect, misses or immunity. Multihit and spread moves count only once. Ability changes and suppression do not reset the spent limit; a genuine switch-in does. The first activation is spent even at +6 Sp. Atk.
